messages:
emily-cs: Heads up — AuroraHealth pilot overnight activity dropped from ~90% -> ~34%. Their nightly batch of embeddings and rerank jobs were paused. Putting the account on renewal-watch.
noah-am: Thanks. Any alerts or recent deploys? Tess, you did the enablement last month right?
tess-csm: Yeah. Champion (Sam) is switching roles this week, so procurement (Olga) is stepping in and mentioned they're running a short bake-off with a competitor.
ivan-eng: Quick triage: no infra OOMs. Saw an increase in 5xx on /v1/rerank around 04:12 UTC and some inconsistent ordering after the last model shuffle. Sample log:
```
2025-11-02T04:12:14Z ERROR rerank: found ordering deviation for request id=aa3f2
```
ivan-eng: Can reproduce ordering flip on their top-10 prompts when using model hornet-v5. Pinning their traffic back to hornet-v4 while we investigate.
deploy-bot: deploy-pin-612 started: aurora-health => hornet-v4 (canary on 2 hosts).
marco-ops: Canary looks healthy so far. No latency regression. Rolling to rest of hosts in 10m.
olga-procurement: Appreciate the quick action. We paused heavy runs because results looked "less stable" and finance flagged cost. If you confirm stability we'll restart nightly jobs.
emily-cs: I'll offer a quick QA session and share a 7-step checklist (smoke prompts + expected ordering + timing checks). Tess, can you lead the QA with Olga?
tess-csm: Yep — will DM checklist and propose a 20-min assisted run tonight.
noah-am: Commercial thought: if they resume and commit to a paid tier, propose a one-week pilot credit + migration support. Hold until we see QA outcome.
ivan-eng: After pin, rerank ordering matches baseline on our 40-case set. We'll block hornet-v5 rollout for Aurora and run a model-eval against their corpus.
olga-procurement: Can you also include a short note on fallback behavior and expected cost delta hornet-v4 -> v5? Procurement wants that for the internal review.
marco-ops: Preparing cost delta numbers now. Quick estimate: +12% token cost for v5 on average; I'll follow up in thread.
emily-cs: Sent update to Olga and Sam's backup. Scheduling QA in 2 hours. Setting renewal-watch and pairing CSM+AM. If procurement still leans competitive after QA, we'll escalate to sales for tailored pricing + migration support. :thumbsup:
